quarterly_data.signal: Rigetti (10-Q): Q2 2026 sales of quantum computers and quantum components were $4.1 million (point-in-time revenue $4,098 thousand) against collaborative research and professional services of $1.0 million; one customer accounted for 64% of Q2 revenue and government entities for 18% (91.7% a year earlier); Asia and other revenue was $3,860 thousand in the six months; deferred revenue rose to $4,014 thousand and remaining performance obligations were approximately $2.7 million.

quarterly_data.signal: Rigetti (10-Q): open purchase orders totaled $35.0 million at June 30, 2026, of which approximately $21.0 million relates to property and equipment; Rigetti may significantly increase capital expenditures to upgrade its chip fabrication facility, purchase additional dilution refrigeration equipment and possibly invest in a new quantum chip fabrication facility. In April 2026 it made the 108-qubit Cepheus-1-108Q generally available through Rigetti QCS and Amazon Braket, and the system is also on Microsoft Azure Quantum and qBraid.
